title: the inference proxy's rename proof runs bin/cairn to see the name resolve, never reads its text
intention: The inference proxy's rename proof measures that the command 'cairn inference' reaches cairn/devices/inferenceproxy, by running bin/cairn in a scratch HOME, and reads none of bin/cairn's source.
why: Measured 2026-11-18: the land of 78a600419a21 at 732da454b ('bin/cairn looks up a declared device name with one grep') reddened cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_the_proxy_stands_at_its_outline_address.py through a text pin. Its tooth-1 check 'bin/cairn maps a typed answers_as to its folder' searched bin/cairn's source for the old block's exact strings, and now reports 'the answers_as block or the bus_name hand-off is absent' (Linux reseal, cairn f9020855d). Through its every-other-proof-is-green tooth, that red also reds test_the_proxy_keeps_its_answers_in_a_tree_and_its_meter_in_the_log.py (red ticket c620e551970f). A text pin on another component's source is RULE 1 coupling in another form.
traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default; green is earned): two inferenceproxy proofs stand red on a check whose behaviour is not shown to have changed. RULE 1: bin is reached only through its public interface, the command.
how: In cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_the_proxy_stands_at_its_outline_address.py, remove the check at :111-114 (read_text of bin/cairn plus 'bin/cairn maps a typed answers_as to its folder'). Add a tooth, bin_cairn_resolves_inference_to_this_folder. Under scratch_dir (imported at call time), with HOME and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT under the scratch and CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH cleared, it (a) writes an executable <root>/inferenceproxy/0/bin/<probe> that prints a marker and its args, runs [_REPO/bin/cairn, 'inference', <probe>, 'x'], and checks the marker and 'x'; (b) points CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH at a scratch stand-in that prints its argv, runs [bin/cairn, 'inference', <scriptless word>, 'x'], and checks argv == ['inference', <word>, 'x']. Both words are asserted absent from cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/bin and 0/bin first. Add a second tooth, the_proof_reads_no_bin_cairn_text, which reads this file's own source and finds no read of bin/cairn. Both join TEETH. A PROVES entry for this ticket maps '1' and '2' to the first tooth and '3' to the second. f942a413f26d's entry stays byte-identical.
constraints: f942a413f26d's PROVES entry and its four tooth functions stay; only the one check() at :111-114 leaves tooth 1
nothing under bin/ is imported or read as text; bin/cairn is only executed
the live ~/.cairn is never written: every run of bin/cairn carries HOME and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT under the scratch

outcomes.claim: in a scratch HOME, 'bin/cairn inference <probe> x' runs <instance root>/inferenceproxy/0/bin/<probe>, and its stdout carries the probe's marker and x
'bin/cairn inference <scriptless word> x' execs the stand-in CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH with argv inference <word> x
the proof's own source reads no bin/cairn text
